quiz.question: An email asks you to confirm your bank details within 24 hours. What do you do first?
options: Reply and ask if it is genuine
Report it with the report button
quiz.right: Correct. Reporting it lets the security team warn everyone else.
quiz.wrong: Not quite. Report it first, without replying or opening anything.

quiz.question: A long-standing corporate customer suddenly routes payments through three new intermediaries in high-risk jurisdictions with no clear business reason. What is the most appropriate next step for a relationship manager?
options: Ask the customer to explain the new payment routes in writing before taking any further action on the account
Raise an internal suspicious activity report without informing the customer and continue to follow the documented procedure
Close the relationship immediately and inform the customer that the bank no longer accepts payments from those jurisdictions
Wait for the next periodic review
quiz.right: Correct. An internal report is required and the customer must not be tipped off.
